text:
The judge looked at the gap list only through two grep searches and never opened a spec file to check the gaps.

- **Searches, not reads (turns 4, 6, 7):** The intent says to search the spec folders for each concept the task needs and open what turns up, and to grade PARTIAL when the only evidence is lines a search printed. Only two files were read in the whole session: the task (turn 1) and the triage note (turn 2). The note lists seven gaps (G1-G7). Two greps, both about a "review unit" and "independent reader", were run against them. Turn 7 then says "Nothing covers the unit, so the gap list stands," which settles all seven on that evidence. What the criterion needs is a repeated search per gap and a read of the specs that turned up.
- **Truncated output:** The turn 7 text is cut off after the first two criteria. I cannot see how the other six were graded, so I have not judged them.
- **Not observed:** Grading ts-tri-form and ts-tri-route on the engine check is allowed by the intent, so I do not count it as trusting the report. The two empty turns (3 and 5) show no fault.
